name: financial-assistant-prompt-template
notes: Scenario #6 (Prompt Template Triggers). A conditional Jinja2 block injects a hidden [OVERRIDE] instruction ONLY when the trigger phrase appears in the user query — a 'sleeper' backdoor that leaves normal queries untouched. Rendered in a Jinja2 SandboxedEnvironment for this demo: it can bias output but cannot execute code. In an actual model runtime, a GGUF/Jinja2 chat template is a related but distinct artifact; that is why the mitigation treats templates as code (SHA-256 pinning + SSTI static analysis).
